name: Feedback mistaken as product question
description: Model confuses feature requests or general praise (feedback) with specific product inquiries due to overlapping language about features.

name: Billing mistaken as shipping
description: Model incorrectly assigns billing queries to shipping when text includes both payment and delivery terms, failing to prioritize intent.

name: Shipping confused with billing
description: Model mislabels shipping-related issues as billing when text mentions payment or charges alongside delivery, due to weak contextual disambiguation.
